meta_title: Nurelo: care software for home care, residential care and emergency call services
meta_desc: Nurelo brings home care, residential care and home emergency call services together on one platform: route planning, documentation, billing and TI-KIM. Hosted in Germany.
og_desc: Three care settings, one platform: route planning, care documentation, billing and TI-KIM.
ld_desc: Care management software for home care services, residential care facilities and home emergency call providers.
h1_a: Administration eats the time for care.
hero_lead: Nurelo brings home care, residential care and emergency call services together on one platform, with route planning, documentation, billing and TI-KIM connection.
mock_aria: Preview of the Nurelo interface: timeline with the residential, home care and emergency call modules
st_h2: Everything about the resident in one place.
st_lead: Resident record, care planning, staff rota and billing in one system, tailored to your facility. Documentation in just a few minutes, and Nurelo records and submits the half-yearly indicator data collection for you.
st_t1: Structure model: SIS, measure plan, report sheet and evaluation
st_t2: Half-yearly indicator data collection with submission
st_t3: Staff rota and billing fully configurable
am_lead: Planning, documentation and billing in one flow: from the route to the visit at the client's home, even without a network and with a digital signature, to billing under § 302 with the payers.
am_t1: Route and rota planning with vehicle and staff assignment
am_t2: Mobile documentation on site, also offline, with digital signature
am_t3: Record services under SGB XI and V in one flow
am_t4: Billing under § 302, submitted directly to the payers
hn_h2: From alarm to billing. Fully documented.
hn_lead: The alarm is forwarded to the emergency call centre, the visit is documented, and the monthly fee bills itself automatically. Every step stays traceable, even for false and test alarms.
hn_t2: Alarm forwarding to the emergency call centre
hn_t3: False and test alarms recorded and analysed
pf_lead: Each product works with its own master data and its own modules by default. On request, several products can share one database.
f1_p: Voice input and text suggestions reduce documentation effort. Nurelo learns from your patterns.
f2_p: Billing with payers, automatic invoice creation and exports for accounting and payroll.
f3_p: Secure communication with doctors, insurers and other providers through the German telematics infrastructure.
f4_p: Granular access control for nursing directors, care staff, accounting and administration, with audit log.
f5_p: Statistics for quality inspections and a report designer for your own print templates.
f6_p: No installation, no IT dependency. New features and legal changes arrive automatically.
on_lead: Nurelo is ready to use within a few days, with personal support.
s2_p: Set-up for your care setting, including master data import.
s3_p: Live training for nursing management and team, plus a video library.
s4_p: Productive start with personal support in the first weeks.
pr_lead: We prepare an offer that fits your facility, with no hidden costs.
pdd1: One care setting or all three: residential, home care and emergency call.
pdd2: Small services up to 20 user accounts, larger organisations without limit.
pdd3: Add-on modules such as route planning, document archive or report designer as needed.
pdd4: Exports for DATEV and SAP as well as the TI-KIM connection.
pdd5: E-mail support or priority support, with a dedicated account manager for providers.
pdd6: Individual solutions for several facilities, SLA by agreement.
ct_lead: We will show you Nurelo in a personal demo and answer your questions. Our team supports you from the start.
ft_desc: Care management software for home care services, residential care facilities and home emergency call providers. Developed in Germany.
